title: CDP Identity Resolution Merges Unrelated Customer Profiles Sharing the Same Postal Code
alternate_search_terms: postal code matching too loose CDP

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's CDP was merging two genuinely different customers into a single profile whenever they shared the same postal code.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The identity-resolution rule set was configured to match on postal code alone as a fallback signal, which was too loose for the customer's customer base density.
resolution_steps: Tighten the identity-resolution ruleset to require postal code plus at least one additional matching signal (email or phone) before merging profiles.
